name: scapular pull up v. 2
description: Hang from a bar and move only your shoulder blades. It builds the shoulder control you need for solid pull-ups.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let your shoulders relax up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together to lift your body a few centimetres.
Keep your elbows locked straight the whole time.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly back to the full hang.
